what-is-autinerary.title: What Autinerary is
transcript: This is Autinerary. It turns a goal into small, clear steps, planned around your energy.
You can start without an account. Say who you're here for, and what you need today.
You get starter resources straight away, picked for your answers.
When you're ready, a free account takes two quick questions: who you're here for, and one goal.
Not sure how to put your goal? Describe it in your own words, then pick a suggestion.
Your path shows one next step at a time.
Each step breaks into small parts, with tools that can help.
Your calendar has low, balanced and high-energy days, so a hard day still has a plan.
In ResourceHub, find services rated by people with similar norms.
In Tidbits, read answers from people with similar experiences.
Autinerary is free during the beta. We don't sell your information, show ads, or use it to train AI. Start with your starter resources, no account needed.

how-to-use-your-path.title: How to use your Path
transcript: Here's how to use your Autinerary path.
Your path shows your next step. Open it to see what to do.
Each step has small parts to do, and tools that can help.
When you've done a step, tick its box on the Races page. Your progress fills in as you go.
On a hard day, open your calendar and choose Low Energy for a lighter plan.
Find services in ResourceHub, and save the ones you want to come back to.
Write in your journal now and then, to see what is working.
The Getting started list on your Path ticks itself off as you try these.
Take it at your own pace. You can replay the tour any time from How it works, in the top bar.
